| Ballot line | Party / Alliance |
|-------------|-------------------|
| **Republican** | New York Republican Party |
| **Conservative** | Conservative Party of New York |
| **Tax Cut Now** | Tax Cut Now Party |

These were the three ballot names listed for Pataki in the official 1994 election record【assistantCOMMENTARY web_fetch {"url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1994_New_York_gubernatorial_election"}】. No other Republican has won the governorship since, and the next Republican to win did so in 2022, but that election’s ballot lines differ (i.e., only the Republican line). Thus, the parties for the last Republican victor when he first secured the office are as listed above.
